newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean shares seen rising, stock firms to lead.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean shares seen rising, stock firms to lead.

text.p: Seoul stocks are likely to rise on Friday buoyed by continued ample liquidity, brokers said.

Securities firms will lead gains on hopes that the recent stock market boom and low interest rates would help their earnings. But blue chips are expected to remain mixed on the lack of strong confidence among investors about an immediate pick-up of the economy, brokers said.
"High liquidity will continue to boost buying, but the market could face profit-taking later today," said Lim Chong-woo of Ssangyong Investment and Securities.
The composite index rose 8.87 points to 774.66 on Thursday.
Brokers said cash liquidity remained high because financial institutions tightened credit offerings to companies since the major corporate failures early this year.
Shares in construction firms were also seen rising on hopes that drops in interest rates would improve earnings at construction firms.
